title: Casper and the Uniform
author: Juniper Underhill
blurb: Elodie Blackwood, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
